gaps.sentence: The closure of the mine will leave four hundred workers ___ (EMPLOY).
gaps.explanation: 'Leave somebody unemployed' — the negative adjective describes the workers.
'A tendency to do something' — noun from tend.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (SAFE) of passengers is our priority.
gaps.explanation: 'Safety' — the quality noun from safe (safe → safety).

gaps.sentence: The team's ___ (LOSE) came as a shock to the fans.
gaps.explanation: 'Their loss' — the noun for a defeat or disappearance.

gaps.sentence: We owe our success to her ___ (VISION) leadership.
He was ___ (APPOINT) at the election result.
The company needs to ___ (MODERN) its factories.
The mountain road has been ___ (WIDE) to cope with coach traffic.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'has been widened' — the verb form meaning made wider.
